name: MetaX MXC500 / MXN100 GPGPU (training and inference)
memory_bandwidth_basis: None available. Memory TYPE is reported (HBM2E for the N100) but capacity and bandwidth are not published in any source located, so no arithmetic intensity can be derived. MetaX's own English product page for the C500 describes 'large-capacity high-bandwidth memory' and 'advanced multi-GPU interconnection (MetaXLink) technology' without a single number (https://www.metax-tech.com/en/goods/prod.html?cid=107&id=21).
notes: THE HIERARCHY POINT: recorded as a single record because MetaX's own taxonomy splits these across two lines that share a silicon family, and the schema has no way to express that: MXN = inference, MXC = training and general computing, MXG = graphics (cn-metax-wikipedia). THE C500 AND N100 FIGURES BELOW BELONG TO DIFFERENT PARTS AND MUST NOT BE ADDED OR CROSS-COMPARED. C500 (training/HPC, June 2023, MACA 2.0, 7 nm): 15 TFLOPS FP32, which the reporting describes as roughly 75% of an A100 - a comparison that is about vector throughput, not tensor throughput, and tells you nothing about how the part handles an LLM. N100 (inference, June 2023, mass production 2023): HBM2E, 160 TOPS INT8 and 80 TFLOPS FP16, with 128-channel 8K encoding and 96-channel decoding across HEVC, H.264, AV1 and AVS2, positioned for smart cities, security, transportation, cloud and video. All figures are flagged vendor_claim: false because they come via a secondary aggregator (Wikipedia, citing DIGITIMES) rather than a MetaX datasheet - MetaX's own product pages carry no numbers. THIS IS THE ONLY CHINESE VENDOR IN THIS SLICE WITH A CONFIRMED CUDA-COMPATIBLE STACK: MACA 2.0, plus an open-source gitee.com/metax-maca and github.com/metax-maca presence and a documented developer community, which makes it the most drop-in candidate of the non-CUDA parts here even though the software is MACA rather than CUDA. VENDOR STATUS IS UNUSUALLY GOOD: MetaX IPO'd on the SSE on 17 December 2025 (ticker 688802), shares up 693% on debut, and filed for a Hong Kong secondary listing in July 2026. DEPLOYMENT SCALE IS THE ONE FIGURE THAT IS WELL-SOURCED AND IT IS LARGE: over 10,000 GPUs across nine compute clusters in commercial operation by end-2024, with C-Series clusters pre-training a billion-parameter MoE model for the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence in June 2024. SUPPLY CHAIN PRESSURE IS DOCUMENTED AND IT SHAPES THE SPEC: in 2024 it was reported MetaX ran out of C500 stock and submitted a downgraded C280 design to TSMC to stay under the US thresholds - the same downgrade-to-comply pattern Reuters documented across several Chinese AI chip firms including Enflame in June 2024. So the 7 nm C500 as originally designed is not what is broadly available today. Also note the C500 is described as the first AI training GPU MetaX successfully tested (June 2023), and the company was founded September 2020 by former AMD engineers.
